assertions.assertion: Output enables all four event categories: RaiseSuccessEvents, RaiseFailureEvents, RaiseErrorEvents, and RaiseInformationEvents on the IdentityServer options
assertions.rationale: Sets all four Raise*Events flags to true in AddIdentityServer options.

assertions.assertion: Output implements IEventSink with a PersistAsync method that receives Event objects
assertions.rationale: SeqEventSink implements IEventSink with PersistAsync(Event evt).

assertions.assertion: Output writes events to Seq using structured logging (e.g., Serilog WriteTo.Seq) with event name, id, and details
assertions.rationale: Uses Serilog WriteTo.Seq and logs {Name}, {Id}, and {@details} structured properties.

assertions.assertion: Output registers the custom event sink in the DI container so IdentityServer uses it
Output notes that registering a custom IEventSink replaces the default (ASP.NET Core logger) sink, so the custom sink must forward to logging if log output is still wanted
assertions.rationale: Has an 'Important' section stating the custom sink replaces the default ILogger sink and explaining how to forward to logging if still desired.
